# The guard and the thing it checks are regenerated by different triggers

## Symptom

`just build-test-fixtures lane=tier2` fails the whole nuttx family at CONFIGURE
time, in an existing build dir:

```
examples/qemu-arm-nuttx/c/talker/build-zenoh/nano_ros_c/builtin_interfaces/msg/
builtin_interfaces_msg_time.h:21:2: error: #error "nros: the generated config
header did not define NROS_CODEGEN_VERSION. This generated artifact cannot tell
whether the runtime accepts it; rebuild the nano-ros runtime so its config
header is regenerated."

ninja: error: rebuilding 'build.ninja': subcommand failed
make[1]: *** [.../nuttx-c-zenoh-all-...mk:10: fixture-0000] Error 1
```

Host-local: it needs a build dir older than `828a06616`. A fresh clone has none,
so **CI cannot hit this** — which is also why it survives unnoticed.

## Cause

`828a06616` (2026-09-05, phase-429 W1, *"the C/C++ version check is a #error,
not a weak symbol"*) added, in ONE commit and correctly paired:

* the `NROS_CODEGEN_VERSION` **define** to
  `packages/api/nros-c/templates/nros_config_generated.h.template`, and
* the consuming `#error` **guard** to every generated message header
  (`packages/cli/rosidl-codegen/packs/_codegen_version.jinja`).

The two artifacts have DIFFERENT regeneration triggers:

| artifact | produced by | re-emitted when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `builtin_interfaces_msg_time.h` (and siblings) | the `nros` CLI's codegen, at CONFIGURE | the CLI changes (`CONFIGURE_DEPENDS`, #182 / issue 1018) |
| `nros_config_generated.h` | `nros-build-helpers`' cargo build script, at BUILD | its own `rerun-if-changed`, which DOES list the template (`packages/tooling/nros-build-helpers/src/c.rs:75`) |

So the dependency edge is NOT missing — the emitter watches the template. The
failure is ORDERING. After a `just setup-cli`, configure re-runs, regenerates the
message headers WITH the new guard, and then a configure-time header compile
check compiles them against the config header still on disk from before
`828a06616`. The emitter that would have refreshed it runs at BUILD, which the
failing configure never reaches.

`ninja: error: rebuilding 'build.ninja'` is the tell: this is a configure
failure, not a compile failure, so "just build again" cannot converge on its own.

## Scope — measured, and it is exactly one family

Every leaf carrying this header, checked for the macro:

```
total=13  stale=13
```

and all 13 are nuttx:

```
examples/qemu-arm-nuttx/c/{talker,listener,service-client,service-server,
                           action-client,action-server}      2026-08-19
examples/qemu-arm-nuttx/cpp/{talker,listener,service-client,service-server,
                             action-client,action-server}    2026-08-29
examples/qemu-riscv-nuttx/c/talker                           2026-08-19
```

No other platform has the header in that layout, so no other family can reach
this state today. That is a property of where nuttx emits (into the leaf's own
`build-*/cargo-target/`) and not a guarantee about other platforms.

## Not yet established

* **Whether an incremental re-run repairs it.** The CLAUDE.md order is: probe the
  edge, `touch` the input, read the `.d` — never wipe first. The one re-run
  attempted was killed by memory pressure before a single family built, so the
  `rm -rf` exemption for "a build that cannot converge" is NOT yet earned. Test
  it before wiping anything.
* Whether `cmake <build-dir>` (the documented re-configure escape hatch for a
  generated build file) is enough, given the failure IS at configure.
* Whether the configure-time header compile check should depend on the config
  header at all, or should run after the emitter — the structural fix, if the
  ordering is the real defect rather than the residue.

## Workaround

`just px4`-style targeted regeneration does not apply here. Until the above is
settled, the narrow move is to delete the 13 stale headers WITH their `.stamp`
siblings so the emitter re-runs — surgical, and the same shape as issue 1082's
fix (delete the specific stale files, never `rm -rf` the tree).
